dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe you should ask for more...

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: And maybe I shouldn't. Once a person has everything they need to live a stable, peaceful life, why should they keep yearning for more?

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: I used to be filled with ambition, but misdirected aspiration ruined my life... I lost every penny I ever had, and worse, thanks to smuggling, I lost my freedom, and thanks to that shipwreck, I lost my family.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Back here in the present, I have nothing, but at least that means I have nothing to lose.
